description: This file contains unit tests for implicit stream subscriptions in an Orleans-based distributed system, specifically testing grain key types with long identifiers. It defines a test class that initializes a test cluster fixture and performs stream-based communication tests.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriptionKeyTypeGrainTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying implicit stream subscriptions with different grain key types, with specific focus on long key types.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class configuring the Orleans test cluster, setting up in-memory storage and streaming providers and clients.

methods.name: LongKey
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that sends a value through a stream with a long grain key and verifies the consumer receives it.

methods.name: CheckValue
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves a value from the grain and asserts its correctness if specified.
